title: Pregnant Blend 3-Mix Duo #26 (세로 띠·물결 / 부채꼴·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large pregnant woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Swedish, in her late 20s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — a stunning hourglass figure carrying a full-term pregnancy, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projecting forward well past her own chest, the navel pushed slightly outward, and below the belly her hips flare wide and curvaceous. Her waistline has fully given way to the pregnancy's round, taut curve, no sharp cinch at the middle, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, very pale, cool skin, a soft white-silver highlighter along the cheekbones, nose bridge and brow bones, pale icy-blue eyeshadow with a fine silver shimmer, pale softly brushed blonde brows, curled light-brown-tipped lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, a sheer frosted pale-pink lip, a cool, calm, faraway expression, cool ash-grey hair styled in a chin-length bob, real pores, real living eyes, ears bare, no piercings, wearing a single piece of silver a hair ornament. Painted in 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 vertical bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 26% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 48% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it is painted in Japanese Kutani porcelain (a cream-white ground with bold red, gold and green overglaze enamels), wide gold-and-red bands following the contours of the body, with overglaze florals filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Peruvian Nazca painted pattern (a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with stepped geometric borders filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it is painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain (a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with tiered lotus-petal work filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, her extreme platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Japanese, in her early 30s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size — but projecting forward prominently from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest,, every other curve of her oversized at once around it: enormous round hips flaring out more than three times the waistline's width, gigantic soft thighs. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her figure is divided into 3 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 53% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 3 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 12 o'clock, 3 o'clock and 7 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 12 o'clock ray and the 3 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, with geometric star filigree filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the wedge between the 3 o'clock ray and the 7 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Nigerian Adire indigo resist-dye (a deep indigo-blue ground with bold white resist-dyed motifs), wide white bands following the contours of the body, with spiral resist motifs filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the wedge between the 7 o'clock ray and the 12 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic (a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs), wide ochre bands following the contours of the body, with spiral floral bands filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
